Change Analysis Report · United States · Category
Search Demand Report
magnesium supplement
As of 2026-10-13 · 2022-09 – 2026-08 · 381 keywords measured
Background and purpose

If searches for 'magnesium supplement' fell or rose, this report checks whether the whole market moved together or only 'magnesium supplement' differs, and what people search for more or less within it. It compares the last 4 years (48 months) of search volume in 1-year periods using ListeningMind United States (Google) search data.

Searches for magnesium supplements grew +217.5% in four years, but every compared supplement grew too, and most grew faster. Inside the category, generic “best” searches are flat, while searches by health condition and by magnesium form are rising fastest.

01Market flow comparison
The whole supplement market rose, and magnesium sits in the middle of the pack
‘vitamin d supplement’ (+1,657.7%) and ‘calcium supplement’ (+775.1%) grew much faster, while ‘iron supplement’ (+130.2%) and ‘potassium supplement’ (+117.3%) grew slower than ‘magnesium supplement’. The verdict does not change when any one comparison is left out.
Weaker than marketmagnesium supplement grew less than vitamin d supplement, zinc supplement, calcium supplement, iron supplement and others
magnesium supplement 4-year +217.5% · similar category median +412.3% · gap −194.8%p
The supplements market is growing — all 5 compared category groups grew, with a median 4-year change of +412.3%. But magnesium supplement grew only +217.5%, so factors specific to magnesium supplement are more likely than the market.

02Target keyword intent change
Health conditions (BP·heart·cramps)4 years +571.8%#5 → #2
Searches by health condition have become the second-largest purpose
‘magnesium supplements for muscle cramps’ is the largest query here, and ‘magnesium supplements for constipation’ (+122.7%) and ‘magnesium supplement eye twitching’ (+107.0%) more than doubled last year. People increasingly search for magnesium by the problem they want to solve.
Magnesium forms (glycinate·citrate·threonate)4 years +613.0%#8 → #6
Searches by magnesium form are growing fastest
‘chelated magnesium supplement’ alone rose +602.2% last year, and ‘elemental magnesium supplement’ (+790.3%) and ‘triple magnesium supplement’ (+190.2%) also climbed. Shoppers are comparing which type of magnesium to buy, not just whether to take it.
Benefits·side effects4 years −24.8%#2 → #5
Basic “what does it do” searches are shrinking
‘benefits of magnesium supplements’ (−21.1%) and ‘magnesium supplements side effects’ (−16.2%) both fell last year, even as the category kept growing. Fewer searches ask whether magnesium works; more ask which one fits a specific need.

At a glance
Background and purpose

If searches for 'magnesium supplement' fell or rose, this report checks whether the whole market moved together or only 'magnesium supplement' differs, and what people search for more or less within it. It compares the last 4 years (48 months) of search volume in 1-year periods using ListeningMind United States (Google) search data.

Searches for magnesium supplements grew +217.5% in four years, but every compared supplement grew too, and most grew faster. Inside the category, generic “best” searches are flat, while searches by health condition and by magnesium form are rising fastest.

Analysis mode · Category — In 1,000 related queries, 131 brands (calcium, take, potassium and others) appear before the item and brand-free modifiers make up 40.4% — a generic term spanning several brands

Market flow comparison
Compared with similar categories: did the whole market move together, or only this category?
The whole supplement market rose, and magnesium sits in the middle of the pack
‘vitamin d supplement’ (+1,657.7%) and ‘calcium supplement’ (+775.1%) grew much faster, while ‘iron supplement’ (+130.2%) and ‘potassium supplement’ (+117.3%) grew slower than ‘magnesium supplement’. The verdict does not change when any one comparison is left out.
Weaker than marketmagnesium supplement grew less than vitamin d supplement, zinc supplement, calcium supplement, iron supplement and others
magnesium supplement 4-year +217.5% · similar category median +412.3% · gap −194.8%p
The supplements market is growing — all 5 compared category groups grew, with a median 4-year change of +412.3%. But magnesium supplement grew only +217.5%, so factors specific to magnesium supplement are more likely than the market.

ListeningMind.AISearch Demand Report · magnesium supplement03
02
Target keyword intent change
What grew or shrank by the purpose people search for together with the target (place, price, form, etc.)
Health conditions (BP·heart·cramps)4 years +571.8%#5 → #2
Searches by health condition have become the second-largest purpose
‘magnesium supplements for muscle cramps’ is the largest query here, and ‘magnesium supplements for constipation’ (+122.7%) and ‘magnesium supplement eye twitching’ (+107.0%) more than doubled last year. People increasingly search for magnesium by the problem they want to solve.
Magnesium forms (glycinate·citrate·threonate)4 years +613.0%#8 → #6
Searches by magnesium form are growing fastest
‘chelated magnesium supplement’ alone rose +602.2% last year, and ‘elemental magnesium supplement’ (+790.3%) and ‘triple magnesium supplement’ (+190.2%) also climbed. Shoppers are comparing which type of magnesium to buy, not just whether to take it.
Benefits·side effects4 years −24.8%#2 → #5
Basic “what does it do” searches are shrinking
